title: look forward to doing
intro: 8 页词汇精讲：盼望做某事 · to 后面接 doing 不是 to do · 邮件/口语/写作高频句型
psleNote: PSLE 真题与升学卷中 look forward to 固定搭配考点。

examples.en: I look forward to seeing you soon.
We are looking forward to the school trip.
She looks forward to meeting her cousin.
examples.zh: 她盼望见到她的表弟/表妹。

examples.en: They looked forward to visiting Chengdu.
I am looking forward to hearing from you.
examples.zh: 我盼望收到你的来信。（邮件常用）

examples.en: Tom looks forward to playing football after exams.
examples.zh: 汤姆盼望考试后踢足球。

examples.en: Emma is looking forward to learning English with you.
examples.zh: 艾玛盼望和你一起学英语。

examples.en: We all look forward to the summer holiday.

pages.title: 听一听 · 盼望见到你
pages.audio: I look forward to seeing you soon.
pages.soundHint: 这是写信结尾常听到的句子，什么意思？
pages.question: 说话的人在表达「盼望」还是「回顾」？
pages.sentence: I look forward to seeing you soon.

pages.title: 苏格拉底 · to 后面接什么？
pages.question: 为什么 say「to seeing」而不是「to see」？

choices.text: to see 也可以，随便用
choices.fb: look forward to 是固定搭配，to 是介词，后面接 doing。

choices.text: to 这里是介词，后面用动名词 -ing
choices.fb: 对了！look forward to doing = 盼望做某事。
这里是动名词，不是进行时。

pages.sentence: I look forward to seeing you soon.

pages.title: 对比 · 正确 vs 错误
pages.lead: 看看哪个句子是地道表达。
pages.leftSentence: I look forward to see you.
pages.rightSentence: I look forward to seeing you soon.
pages.discovery: look forward to + doing（动名词），永不接 to do！

pages.title: 分类篮 · 正确还是错误？
pages.lead: 哪些句子用了正确的 look forward to doing？

items.text: I look forward to meeting you.
I look forward to meet you.
items.hint: to 后要用 meeting，不是 meet。

items.text: She looks forward to visiting Chengdu.
He looks forward to go home.
We are looking forward to the trip.
They look forward to play games.

pages.title: 搭配卡 · 三种时态
pages.lead: look forward to 可用于一般现在、现在进行、一般过去。

rules.rule: look(s) forward to + doing / 名词
rules.sample: She looks forward to meeting her cousin.

rules.rule: be looking forward to + doing / 名词（更生动）
rules.sample: I am looking forward to hearing from you.

pages.title: 限时快选 · 固定搭配
pages.q: We look forward to _____ Chengdu this summer.
pages.sentence: They looked forward to visiting Chengdu.

pages.title: 听音排序 · 邮件句
pages.audio: I look forward to seeing you soon.
pages.sentence: I look forward to seeing you soon.

pages.title: 写作模板 · 邮件结尾
checklist: 结构：look forward to + doing / 名词
邮件结尾：I look forward to hearing from you.
口语：I'm looking forward to the weekend!
易错：× look forward to see → ✓ look forward to seeing
pages.chant: Look forward to — then -ing you use! Meeting, visiting — never infinitive!
pages.chantSpeak: Look forward to, then ing you use! Meeting, visiting, never infinitive!
